title: Senior Software Engineer — Backend
description: We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable microservices powering our data platform. You will work closely with product and data teams to deliver high-quality, production-grade Python services with strong test coverage.
requirements: 5+ years of professional Python development experience
Deep expertise in FastAPI, Django, or Flask
Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills (query optimisation, indexing, schema design)
Experience designing and consuming RESTful and gRPC APIs
Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments
Strong understanding of distributed systems, caching (Redis), and message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar)
Ability to lead technical design discussions and mentor junior engineers
nice_to_have: Experience with Apache Spark or dbt for data pipelines
Familiarity with AWS or GCP cloud services

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Join our ML team to build, train, and deploy production machine learning models that power personalization, fraud detection, and recommendation features across our platform.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in ML engineering or applied ML research
Strong Python skills with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar MLOps platforms
Proficiency in feature engineering and data preprocessing at scale
Solid understanding of model training, evaluation, and deployment lifecycle
Experience serving ML models via REST APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma) for embedding-based systems
nice_to_have: Experience with LLMs, RAG, or generative AI applications
Knowledge of model quantisation and performance optimisation
Experience with Spark for large-scale feature engineering

title: Senior Frontend Engineer — React
description: We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead the development of our next-generation web product, focusing on performance, accessibility, and delightful user experiences.
requirements: 5+ years of frontend development experience
Expert-level React.js (hooks, context, performance patterns)
Strong TypeScript skills
Experience with state management (Redux, Zustand, or React Query)
Deep understanding of web performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting)
Proficiency with testing frameworks: Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright
Solid understanding of REST and GraphQL APIs

title: DevOps / Platform Engineer
description: Build and maintain the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and observability stack that enables our engineering teams to ship fast and reliably.
requirements: 3+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering role
Deep hands-on AWS experience (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFormation/Terraform)
Strong Kubernetes administration skills
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Pulumi)
Monitoring and observability experience (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python)
nice_to_have: Experience with FinOps and cloud cost optimisation
